analysis.summary_en: Trail-code gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other coding agents a map of your code, and what your team has learned about it.
highlights: Entry-point trace: Trace end-to-end what happens when a client creates a record via the REST API, from route handler to database write.
Keep defaultRetryMax = 4: ten retries with the default backoff can hold one Do() call for over an hour.
The right code with every prompt.
Raising the default to 10 for one customer: worst case, a single Do() call blocks for over an hour.
